name: FOSSIL INDEX — Wave Concatenation Spine
description: Each wave deposits a fossil. Fossils stack. The index is the spine that connects them all. Diff any two fossils to see what changed. Read the sequence to see the organism evolve.
policy: APPEND ONLY. Never delete. Never edit old fossils. Each wave adds a new entry.
